levels.surface: جعفر بن محمد بن مالك الفزاري

notes: «قالوا عرض علينا أبو محمد الحسن بن علي» names the Imam in the words after the chain: he is the last link (owner ruling 2). Surface copied as the report names him.
The three co-transmitters «حدثني معاوية ... و ... و ... قالوا» form one level.
«2-» is the report number; the blessing after the Companion names is left out.
